interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk on at least one side of the street to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Apply paint markings to define travel lanes and parking zones, which helps narrow the perceived roadway and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement to ensure a smooth and safe surface for all road users.

interventions.title: Speed Humps

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Clearances
